device.mode: Chrome headless on the local Windows device, real offline file entry and DOM keyboard/mouse; this is not a manual foreground-device test.

memory.method: Read-only CDP Runtime.getHeapUsage sampled every five seconds without forced garbage collection; privacy-rounded performance.memory is retained separately in samples.
memory.note: Frame samples are drained approximately every five seconds and retained in the Node harness, outside the measured page heap. Page heap floors are observations, not a leak-proof guarantee. The pass flag checks frame budget, density and fatal errors; memory trend requires separate review.

passScope: Frame budget, 24 live actors, no page errors and no remote requests. Heap trend is separately reviewed from precise CDP samples; this flag is not a memory-leak guarantee.
